## Checklist

- [ ] I wrote these files myself, **or** I have permission to share them (see [CONTENT-LICENSE.md](https://github.com/9da62c42/physics_file_sharing/blob/main/CONTENT-LICENSE.md)).
- [ ] I only chose licences for work that is mine; course material is marked `STUDY` or with the licence it was published under.
- [ ] No other personal information (phone numbers, grades, ID photos). I know a student number in a file's ID will be public.
- [ ] Nothing here is a paid textbook, a solution manual, or an exam that isn't meant to be public.
